title: PROJECTILE MAYHEM: Zero-Point Demolition
description: Transform every projectile into a high-precision explosive with a 100% impact guarantee on any surface.
body:
**🔥 Why Choose Projectile Mayhem?**
Unlike basic data packs that only check for "ground" impact, our Phantom Trail Engine tracks the projectile's existence. If it hits a ceiling, a wall, or a hidden corner—it WILL explode. No skips, no duds, just pure destruction.

**💎 Key Features:**
6-Axis Collision Detection: Using advanced AEC (Area Effect Cloud) logic, the pack detects impact on any surface, including ceilings and vertical walls.

**Smart Safety Fuse:** Built-in protection that prevents explosions within a 5-block radius of the player. Stay safe while raining fire. Only the fishing rod can bypass the protection so keep your distance.

**Titanium Skin (Auto-Buff)**: Holding an Ender Pearl automatically grants you Resistance IV. This ensures you survive high-stakes teleports and close-quarter combat.

**Zero-Lag Optimization:** Clean code designed for performance. Perfect for both single-player survival and chaotic multiplayer servers.

**🛠️ Weapon Specifications:**
Snowballs, Tridents: Rapid-fire harassment

Eggs & Wind Charges: Tactical breach charges

Arrows & Fishing Hooks: Long-range sniping and remote mining.

Ender Pearls: High-yield demolition with safe-travel shielding.

_If you want to see it by yourself, be my guest!_

**Hope you enjoy this pack and see ya!**
